arxiv-2103-05250.title: ByteSGAN: A Semi-supervised Generative Adversarial Network for Encrypted Traffic Classification of SDN Edge Gateway in Green Communication Network Thanks: The paper is sponsored by National Natural Science Fundation (General Program) Grant 61972211, China, and National Key Research and Development P
arxiv-2103-05250.creator: 1 st Pan Wang, 2 nd Zixuan Wang, 3 rd Feng Ye, 4 th Xuejiao Chen
arxiv-2103-05250.description: Abstract With the rapid development of Green Communication Network, the types and quantity of network traffic data are accordingly increasing. Network traffic classification become a non-trivial research task in the area of network management and security, which not only help to improve the fine-grained network resource allocation, but also enable policy-driven network management.

arxiv-2103-16401.title: Parabolic rectifiability, tangent planes and tangent measures
arxiv-2103-16401.creator: Pertti Mattila
arxiv-2103-16401.description: Abstract . We define rectifiability in ℝ n × ℝ \mathbb{R}^{n}\times\mathbb{R} with a parabolic metric in terms of C 1 C^{1} graphs and Lipschitz graphs with small Lipschitz constants and we characterize it in terms of approximate tangent planes and tangent measures. We also discuss relations between the parabolic rectifiability and other notions of rectifiability.

arxiv-2204-12360.title: Onset of common envelope evolution during a core helium flash by rapid envelope expansion
arxiv-2204-12360.creator: Stanislav Fainer, Ealeal Bear, Noam Soker
arxiv-2204-12360.description: Abstract We suggest that the vigorous core convection during core helium flash on the tip of the red giant branch (RGB) of low mass stars excites waves that carry energy to the envelope and inflate it for few years to increase the number of extreme horizontal branch (EHB; sdB and sdO) stars with masses of ≃ 0.

arxiv-2205-05084.title: Bias and Priors in Machine Learning Calibrations for High Energy Physics Preprint: MIT-CTP 5432
arxiv-2205-05084.creator: Rikab Gambhir, Benjamin Nachman, Jesse Thaler
arxiv-2205-05084.description: Abstract Machine learning offers an exciting opportunity to improve the calibration of nearly all reconstructed objects in high-energy physics detectors. However, machine learning approaches often depend on the spectra of examples used during training, an issue known as prior dependence. This is an undesirable property of a calibration, which needs to be applicable in a variety of environments.

arxiv-2301-01179.title: A Fast Multipole Method for axisymmetric domains
arxiv-2301-01179.creator: Michael J. Carley
arxiv-2301-01179.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Michael J. Carley. The Fast Multipole Method (FMM) for the Poisson equation is extended to the case of non-axisymmetric problems in an axisymmetric domain, described by cylindrical coordinates. The method is based on a Fourier decomposition of the source into a modal expansion and the evaluation of the corresponding modes of the field using a two-dimensional tree decomposition in the radial and axial coordinate.

arxiv-2302-10134.title: Gauge Symmetry of the Chiral Schwinger model from an improved Gauge Unfixing formalism
arxiv-2302-10134.creator: Gabriella V. Ambrósio, Cleber N. Costa, Paulo R. F. Alves, Everton M. C. Abreu, Jorge Ananias Neto, Ronaldo Thibes
arxiv-2302-10134.description: Abstract In this paper, the Hamiltonian structure of the bosonized chiral Schwinger model (BCSM) is analyzed. From the consistency condition of the constraints obtained from the Dirac method, we can observe that this model presents, for certain values of the α \alpha parameter, two second-class constraints, which means that this system does not possess gauge invariance.

arxiv-2402-15350.title: Farsight : Fostering Responsible AI Awareness During AI Application Prototyping Conference: Proceedings of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; May 11–16, 2024; Honolulu, HI, USA Proceedings of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI ’24), May 11–16, 2024,
arxiv-2402-15350.creator: Zijie J. Wang, Chinmay Kulkarni, Lauren Wilcox, Michael Terry, Michael Madaio
arxiv-2402-15350.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zijie J. Wang, Chinmay Kulkarni, Lauren Wilcox, Michael Terry, Michael Madaio. Prompt-based interfaces for Large Language Models (LLMs) have made prototyping and building AI-powered applications easier than ever before. However, identifying potential harms that may arise from AI applications remains a challenge, particularly during prompt-based prototyping. To address this, we present Farsight , a novel in situ interactive tool that helps people identify potential harms from the AI applications they are prototyping.

arxiv-2411-01553.title: Learning to Communicate Through Implicit Communication Channels
arxiv-2411-01553.creator: Han Wang, Binbin Chen, Tieying Zhang, Baoxiang Wang
arxiv-2411-01553.description: Abstract Effective communication is an essential component in collaborative multi-agent systems. Situations where explicit messaging is not feasible have been common in human society throughout history, which motivate the study of implicit communication. Previous works on learning implicit communication mostly rely on theory of mind (ToM), where agents infer the mental states and intentions of others by interpreting their actions.

pmc-10737937.title: LOCATION MODERATES THE EFFECT OF COGNITIVE TRAINING ON CRASH RISK OVER 20 YEARS: AN ANALYSIS OF THE ACTIVE STUDY
pmc-10737937.creator: Katie Wheeler, Tyler Bell, Brooke Carroll, Caitlin Pope, Karlene Ball, Olivio Clay, Despina Stavrinos, Sheila Black
pmc-10737937.description: Driving is a critical everyday function that helps older adults remain independent. The Advanced Cognitive Training in Vital Elderly (ACTIVE) study has shown cognitive training improves driving safety outcomes for older adults. Few studies have examined the longitudinal effects of cognitive training on crash risk beyond 5 years.

pmc-11414196.title: Whether T-tube biliary drainage is necessary after pancreaticoduodenectomy: a single-center retrospective study
pmc-11414196.creator: Xin Luo, Xinbin Zhuo, Xianchao Lin, Ronggui Lin, Yuanyuan Yang, Congfei Wang, Haizong Fang, Heguang Huang, Fengchun Lu
pmc-11414196.description: BackgroundPostoperative complications of pancreaticoduodenectomy (PD) are still a thorny problem. This study aims to verify the preventative impact of T-tube on them.MethodsThe electronic medical records and follow-up data of patients who received pancreaticoduodenectomy in our center from July 2016 to June 2020 were reviewed.

pmc-11582372.title: Effect of shared decision-making in patients with breast cancer undergoing breast reconstruction surgery: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11582372.creator: Lixia Chen, Jia Lu, Bo Chen, Xiaoxia Zhang
pmc-11582372.description: ObjectivePatients with breast cancer who must undergo breast mastectomy are offered different types of breast reconstruction surgeries. Shared decision-making (SDM) is an important emerging intervention in the decision-making process of patients. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of SDM in patients with breast cancer undergoing breast reconstruction surgery.

pmc-12451534.title: Music therapy for patients with depression: systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
pmc-12451534.creator: Youn Joo Lee, Seog Ju Kim, Jihyun Yoon, Jung Hwan Lee
pmc-12451534.description: BackgroundDepression is one of the most common mental diseases, leading to a decline in both psychiatric and physical functions. One non-pharmacological therapeutic strategy for the management of psychiatric disorders is music therapy.AimsTo assess the clinical effectiveness of music therapy and its various subscales for managing depressive symptoms (primary outcome) and related problems (secondary outcome) in comparison with other conventional treatments.

pmc-12514574.title: WNT7A/B assemble a GPR124-RECK-LRP5/6 coreceptor complex to activate β-catenin signaling in brain endothelial cells
pmc-12514574.creator: Robin Heiden, Laura Hannig, Calvin J. Kuo, Süleyman Ergün, Barbara M. Braunger, Mario Vallon
pmc-12514574.description: WNT7A and WNT7B, secreted by neural cells, are essential regulators of developmental brain angiogenesis and blood–brain barrier integrity. In brain endothelial cells, WNT7 proteins activate β-catenin signaling through the ligand-specific receptor complex GPR124-RECK and classical WNT receptors of the FZD and LRP families. Previous studies suggested that WNT7 isoforms assemble a GPR124-RECK-FZD-LRP5/6 multireceptor complex for signaling.

uslaw-usc-t16-s837h.title: 16 U.S.C. § 837h — Provisions not applicable to Canyon Ferry project or benefits and exchanges under Treaty between Canada and United States; preference of power users in Montana not modified

uslaw-usc-t16-s837h.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 12F (Pacific Northwest Consumer Power Preference; Reciprocal Priority In Other Regions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
